L25n2403.name: Access rights, strict security
L25n2403.description: Goes negative on words of strictness or access control in security and login text, e.g. 'explicit' boundaries, 'Strict'ly, 'stricter' partitioning, 'compromised', 'customizable' user profiles; pushes toward 'rights' and 'access' tokens.

L26n1292.name: Mid-word fragment, 'segment' output
L26n1292.description: Fires on a non-final piece of a word split across tokens, mostly in plant, fruit and place names (agr in bermudagrass, ax in flaxseed, ost in mangosteen, rd in Córdoba, ic in jicama); pushes toward 'segment' tokens.

L26n2325.name: Split medical word fragments
L26n2325.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a split word, most often body and medical terms (co in cochlea, eyel in eyelids, ang in angina, br in bruxism, eb in eyebrow); pushes toward 'flat' and 'straight'.

L26n540.name: Split-word start, hyphen output
L26n540.description: Fires on an early piece of a word split across tokens (be in embezzlement, emb in embrittlement, ca in castrated, ant in antlers, ral in sucralose); pushes toward a hyphen or dash '-' token.

L26n1798.name: Nerve-root and name fragments
L26n1798.description: Fires on 'nerve' in 'nerve root' compression text and on mid-word pieces of names (Nes in Nesbitt, ensch in Schenkenschans, Mel in Melvin); pushes toward 'signal' tokens.

L25n162.name: Latin species-name fragments
L25n162.description: Goes negative on a fragment of Latin species and genus names (Pl in Platanus, alex in alexandri, h in huxleyi, chin in chinensis, yle in Xyleborus); pushes toward 'wait' tokens.

L26n1751.name: Place-name openers, 'European' output
L26n1751.description: Goes negative on the opening piece of a place or region name (And in Andalusia, West in West Africa or West Indies, Rod in Rodinia) and on 'establishing' before European bodies; pushes toward 'European', 'Europe' and 'EU'.

L25n1549.name: Scattered split-word openers
L25n1549.description: Goes negative on pieces of split words across unrelated topics (Sup in Supposedly, ou in Rambouillet, ap in Hunga Tonga, p in Wellpinit, ground in ground beetles, nap in napkins); no single topic; pushes toward 'cover' tokens.

L26n1274.name: Linking words in titles
L26n1274.description: Goes negative on the 'of', 'the' or 'New' that link words inside institution, journal and society titles (Board of Periodontology, Journal of Toxic, Daughters of the Confederacy, University of New Mexico, Division of Vital Statistics); pushes toward 'Ab', 'AB' and 'abstract' tokens.

L25n1966.name: Opening fragment, 'kneading'
L25n1966.description: Goes negative on the opening fragment of a split word, most strongly 'kne' in kneading or kneaded (also 'Sh' in shaped and 'Z' in Zaidi); pushes toward 'assume' and 'assumption' tokens.

L26n759.name: Word before bare verb
L26n759.description: Fires on the word just before a bare verb is expected: 'to' after 'allows users', 'calls' or 'wish', 'can' or 'will' before a verb, and 'Please' opening an instruction; also 'wh' starts of verbs (whistling, whizz); pushes toward 'book' tokens.

L26n1422.name: Lone 'f' word opener
L26n1422.description: Fires on a lone 'f' that opens a word split into 'f' plus the rest (f in fostering, fathom, fiddled, fashions, flossing), plus 'conf' in confute and '-dis' in self-discovery; pushes toward 'discovery' tokens.

L26n2595.name: Proper-name opener fragments
L26n2595.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a multi-token proper name, such as people and places (Sin in Sintra, Su in Suess, Moh in Mohenjo-daro, Ru in Rushd, Fab in Fabergé); pushes toward 'continue' tokens.

L25n517.name: Festival and holiday words
L25n517.description: Fires on festival and holiday vocabulary, most on 'festival', 'Festival' and 'holiday' (also 'F' starts such as Fritters); pushes toward 'delight', 'beauty' and 'joy' tokens.

L26n369.name: Recipe numerals, Sp-words
L26n369.description: Goes negative on the numeral that starts a recipe quantity ('1' in '1 tablespoon', '2' in '2 tablespoons') and on 'Sp' openers (spinal, spicy, spelling); pushes toward ellipsis '…' tokens.

L26n2634.name: Preposition before place name
L26n2634.description: Goes negative on the 'in', 'of' or 'the' just before a place name ('in Italy', 'of the Two Sicilies') and on the starts of names like Pisa, Pavia and Waal; pushes toward blank whitespace, which the steered story fills with spaces.

L26n614.name: Person-name opener fragments
L26n614.description: Goes negative on the split-off piece of a person's name (En in Enola, oko in Yoko, Ben in Benito, uda in Yehuda), mainly first names; pushes toward male given names such as Charles, William and Thomas.

L26n1942.name: Mid-word stem fragments
L26n1942.description: Fires on a non-final stem piece of a word split across tokens, with no single topic (absor in absorber, dri in driest, scr in scraping, num in numbs, ar in armpits); pushes toward 'align' and 'alignment' tokens.

L26n2087.name: Word-opener fragments, 'break'
L26n2087.description: Goes negative on the opening piece of split words and names (Ish in Ishiguro, bra in braids, pa in palettes, Gra in Graubünden, anch in disenfranchised); pushes toward 'break' tokens.

L26n1660.name: Ar/Mer word openers
L26n1660.description: Goes negative on the 'Ar' or 'Mer' opening piece of split words (Ar in arthritis, arsenic, archaeology; Mer in Merino, Merlins, Merthyr), also 'ter' in mites; pushes toward 'animal' tokens.

L25n1524.name: Split noun fragments, code
L25n1524.description: Fires on the first piece of a noun split across tokens inside long lists of animals, plants or places (mac|aws, cor|als, Por|ifera, Not|re-Dame), and on SQL '_id' and 'h(x' maths. Pushes toward '=' signs in code.

L25n645.name: Word stem needing suffix
L25n645.description: Fires on a word stem split across tokens that still needs a suffix: 'vir' in retro|viruses, 'hor' in hor|izons, 'Hor' in Hor|rible, '-cigaret' before 'te', 'dwar' before 'fs'. Pushes toward suffix pieces like -ations, -ivement, -ures.

L26n466.name: Proper-name opening fragment
L26n466.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a capitalised place or person name split across tokens (La| Coupole, Aeth|iopia, Le|nhall, Koh|li) and on city names in lists. Pushes toward 'available', 'possible' and 'applicable'.

L26n2617.name: Words before room/space
L26n2617.description: Goes strongly negative on the word just before an expected 'room' or 'space' noun: 'free' in 'free space', 'provide' and 'enough' and 'ample' before room or space, 'much' and 'little' before a noun of space. Pushes toward 'room'.

L25n882.name: Name and list openers
L25n882.description: Goes negative on tokens that open a list or a title: 'as' in 'such as', 'on' in 'Follow Math Help Forum on Facebook', capital 'A' starting a clause or name, and the second piece of split names (Karn|ail, Cinnam|om). Pushes toward 'summary'.

L26n1510.name: Before 'used to' phrase
L26n1510.description: Goes negative on the word right before an expected 'used to' or 'accustomed to' phrase: 'isn't' before 'used to', 'get' and 'got' in 'get used to' or 'get in shape', and 'so' or 'more' before an adjective. Pushes toward 'used' and 'usage'.

L26n258.name: Joiners in compounds
L26n258.description: Fires on the piece right after a compound joiner or punctuation in citations, URLs and technical terms: 'bio' in biofuels, 'o' in osteo|arthritis, 'xy' in hydro|xy|apatite, and '(' or '“' before a unit or quote. Pushes toward short word-ending pieces (-er, -ed, -en).

L26n962.name: Name-start fragments, history
L26n962.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a capitalised proper name split across tokens, mostly place and people names in history text: 'Vers' in Versailles, 'Pers' in Persians, 'Ger' in Gertrude, 'Her' in Herlyne, 'S' in Sardis. Pushes toward 'site'.

L26n623.name: Infinitive 'to' before verb
L26n623.description: Fires on the infinitive 'to', or a modal ('can', 'will', 'not'), right before a bare verb: 'to' in 'designed to evaluate', 'to' in 'used to get', 'can' in 'can use', 'will' in 'will install'. Pushes toward bare verbs such as test, train and check.

L25n1708.name: Ambiguous 'Mer' word-starts
L25n1708.description: Fires on a 2-3 letter word start that is not yet a whole word, most often 'Mer' or 'Mor' (Mer|lins, Mer|ck, Mor|avian, Mer|cury), and 'ev' or 'yst' (ev|okes, poly|styrene). Pushes toward 'clear', 'clearly' and 'explicit'.

L26n2281.name: Capitalised name fragments
L26n2281.description: Goes negative on the first or middle piece of a capitalised name split across tokens: 'ñ' in Piñera, 'Ar' in d'Arno, 'Pic' in Picual, 'Maj' in Majorelle, 'Ang' in Angara, 'ist' in Armistice. Pushes toward 'remote' and 'far'.

L26n1079.name: Capital letters opening names
L26n1079.description: Goes negative on the capital first letter or first piece of a name or acronym mid-sentence: 'H' in Houdon, 'H' in HSPH, 'Sch' in Schwann and Schiffman, 'F' in FACC, '-H' in McGraw-Hill. Pushes toward '--' dashes.

L25n252.name: Formula and URL tokens
L25n252.description: Fires on the digit, letter or '(x' right after '=' or '(' inside formulas, code and URL query strings: '1' in 'Cr1=', '4' in '=(B2+B35', '(x' in 'h(x) = y', 'category=', and 'ALL' in sudoers lines. Pushes toward '=' signs in code.

L26n2935.name: Foreign name middle pieces
L26n2935.description: Fires on a middle or final piece of a multi-token proper name, typically non-English: 'ah' in Maz|ah|eri, 'á' in Kár|old, 'azar' in Alc|azar|as, 'Ho' in Ho|jiblanca, 'Lak' in Lak|shmi. Pushes toward 'plot'.

L26n2190.name: Consonant-cluster word starts
L26n2190.description: Fires on the first piece of a word starting with a consonant cluster, especially 'gr', 'qu', 'st' and 'cl' split across tokens: 'Gr' in Gr|ating, 'qu' in qu|asar, 'log' in crystal|log|raphy, 'st' in st|itions. Pushes toward 'star' and 'stars'.

L26n2152.name: 'a' before quantity phrase
L26n2152.description: Goes negative on the indefinite 'a' that opens a quantity phrase: 'there are a few', 'a lot of', 'a huge number', 'a series of', 'a proliferation'. Pushes toward 'string', a weak link to the reading.

L25n550.name: Commonwealth place names
L25n550.description: Fires on the second or later word or piece of a proper name in Australian, New Zealand and UK exam-board text: 'New' in New Zealand or New South Wales, 'NSW', 'Queensland', 'SE' in GCSE, 'excel' in Pearson Edexcel, and commas in place lists. Pushes toward meaningless fragments like 'avored' and 'umor'.

L26n80.name: Short stem fragments
L26n80.description: Fires on a short word stem split across tokens that begins a verb or noun: 'rel' in rel|ieves, 'prov' in prov|okes, 'st' in st|ews and st|umbles, 'r' in r|ipples. Also fires on list commas after 'such as' and 'Chess,'. Pushes toward quote and comma runs such as ';' and ';,'.

L26n1299.name: 'br' word-start fragments
L26n1299.description: Fires on the first piece of a word starting 'br', 'fr', 'Fl' or 'thr' split across tokens, most strongly 'br' in bruxism (br|uxism), also Br|unsbüttel and thr|ong. Pushes toward 'company' and 'companies'.

L25n976.name: Prepositions before complements
L25n976.description: Goes negative on a preposition or article that opens a complement: 'over' in 'over medium heat', 'of' in 'War of 1812', 'in' in 'in a straight line', 'a' in 'to a minimum'. Also fires on word fragments like 'es' in Thespians and 'he' in cathep|sin. Pushes toward 'unknown' and 'empty'.

L26n550.name: Mid-name subword fragments
L26n550.description: Negative on a mid-word piece of a place or person name split into tokens, usually the first or second piece (Có|rdoba, Fort Det|rick, Nil|otes), often after 'in' or 'at'; pushes toward word-ending 'd' tokens, not the names.

L26n325.name: Word stem before suffix
L26n325.description: Negative on the stem piece of a word split before its suffix (attrib|utions, trib|une, compl|ies, dec|imation, res|ided, defin|ately), so it marks a word still waiting for its ending; pushes toward suffix pieces like '-orarily' and '-ations'.

L25n2207.name: Ex- and non- prefixes
L25n2207.description: Negative on prefix pieces that open a negated or existence word (pre-ex|posure, non|-working, non|tribosphenic, ex|oplanets) and on some name starts (G|utzon); pushes toward 'exist' and 'existing'.

L26n2301.name: Proper-name first fragment
L26n2301.description: Negative on the first subword of a capitalized name, mostly person or place names after 'of', 'in', or a comma (Sul|foxaflor, T|endulkar, Ash|kelon, Dor|set, Sus|ilo); pushes toward 'cloud'.

L26n2566.name: Ancient name starts
L26n2566.description: Negative on the first piece of a split proper or technical word, mostly ancient names and terms (Tar|quin, Sar|acen, Ass|ites, Ṛ|daya, bel|ittled, cred|iting); pushes toward the '&' token.

L25n2750.name: Multi-token name starts
L25n2750.description: Positive on the first piece of a multi-token place or organization name, right after 'at', 'in', or 'of' (Marr|akesh, Bureau of Indian Standards, Chern|obyl, Nord|hausen, Mart|el); pushes toward 'missing'. Opposite sign to the negative name-start poles.

L26n1446.name: Words before 'network'
L26n1446.description: Positive on the word just before a set term's head noun, e.g. 'Telephone' in Telephone Network, 'scientific' in scientific community, 'the' before network; much weaker on other compound heads. Pushes toward 'net'.

L26n3038.name: Color words
L26n3038.description: Positive on color words themselves (red, blue, yellow, gray, green, colour, color), most on 'red' and 'Red'; pushes toward 'green'.

L26n523.name: Technical nouns in ML
L26n523.description: Negative on the word just before a technical noun in ML, data-science, and linguistics text ('for' in 'for calculating', 'and' in 'tree-based', 'language' in 'natural language', 'a' in 'a data analysis'); pushes toward 'syntax' and 'sentence'.

L25n2150.name: Months and conversational tone
L25n2150.description: Negative on 'convers' in 'conversational tone' prompts, on 'ger' in germs and geriatrics, and on the word just before a month or season ('coolest month ... is' June, 'mid-' June); pushes toward month names.

L26n1373.name: Mid-word name fragments
L26n1373.description: Negative on mid-word pieces of place, person, and technical names split into tokens (Meg|iddo, Gen|oa, Ph|ra, Cam|eras, Mark scheme, Ta|rsal), in history, geography, and tech prose; pushes toward 'down'.

L26n2847.name: Research-framing words
L26n2847.description: Positive on words that frame a study, gap, or claim (and, significant, raises, these, those, Research, Study), e.g. 'several significant gaps' or 'address these issues'; pushes toward 'method'.

L26n2900.name: Subword 'ep' starts
L26n2900.description: Negative on the 'ep' or 'p' piece that opens a word split into tokens (ep|idermis, Ep|iphanes, ep|inephrine, ocean p|out), in anatomy and history text; pushes toward 'host'.

L26n1269.name: Word-initial 'j'
L26n1269.description: Positive on a 'j' that opens a split word, mostly construction and lumber terms (j|amb, j|icama, j|acks, j|igsaw, j|argon, j|uts); also 'tai' in tai chi. Pushes toward 'studies' and 'tests'.

L26n1980.name: Tarquin and Ne- starts
L26n1980.description: Positive on the first piece of a split name or science word (Tar|quin, Ne|utrons, V|itiligo, El|ham, Bl|aeu, rav|ens, power sector); pushes toward 'bus'.

L25n1475.name: Medical term first pieces
L25n1475.description: Positive on the first piece of a split medical or science term (pan|leukopenia, ul|iflower, Astr|onomical, neu|romas, ech|inococcus, ren|alin); pushes toward 'data'.

L26n391.name: Stems before -ly adverbs
L26n391.description: Positive on the stem piece of an adverb split before its '-ly' ending (satisf|actorily, compreh|ensively, uncon|sciously, harmon|iously, immun|ologically, chem|ically); pushes toward 'clearly' and 'completely'.

L25n2953.name: Word-initial 'Bo' and 'De'
L25n2953.description: Positive on the first piece of a split word, often 'Bo' and 'De' (Bo|aters, Bo|is Blanc, De|portation, fo|am), and on 'rh' in mycorrhizae; pushes toward 'growth' and 'grow'.

L26n59.name: Chat turn-boundary newline
L26n59.description: Negative on the newline after <|im_end|> just before '<|im_start|>assistant' in chat prompts, and on template tokens like 'system', 'assistant', and '</think>'; pushes toward curly quotes and ellipses.

L25n2716.name: Proper-name mid pieces
L25n2716.description: Negative on a mid-word piece of a multi-token proper name (Dom|esday, Fu|hrer, Heze|kiah, Ram|eses, Hor|owitz, Kle|bsiella, Ru|shd), usually the first or second piece; pushes toward 'normal' and 'ordinary'.

L26n1728.name: Mid-word name fragments
L26n1728.description: Goes strongly negative on a non-final piece of a word or name the tokenizer split (Me|ister, Ed|ub|logs, Le|ib|niz, Man|itoba, Ber|iber|i, Frank|l), mostly the first or middle piece before the word ends. Pushed negative it steers output toward 'friend'.

L26n455.name: Un- negation prefix onset
L26n455.description: Goes strongly negative on the 'un' token that opens a negated word, right before its stem (un|important, un|utilized, un|qualified, un|vaccinated, un|claimed, un|hiding), and on special-|abled. Pushed negative it steers output toward 'c'-type fragments (cy, cie), which do not match the reading.

L25n2262.name: Proper-noun first pieces
L25n2262.description: Goes strongly negative on the first or middle piece of a capitalized proper name split into tokens (Sar|ab|hai, Bu|thidae, Beth|any, Chern|ob|yl, X|erxes), often right after 'King' or a place word. Pushed negative it steers output toward 'shift'.

L26n2374.name: Split name/word starts
L26n2374.description: Fires on the first piece of a name or word split into several tokens (Kos|rae, Có|rdoba, Ell|sworth, sap|otilla, pol|yc|rystalline, e|icos|apentaenoic), and on some whole words in phrases like 'crop' and 'Grand Canyon'. Pushed positive it steers output toward 'ring'.

L26n153.name: Capitalized name starts, units
L26n153.description: Fires on the first piece of a capitalized name or noun-phrase opener (Le|ashes, Batter|ies, Kings Cross, Men's, Que|ensland, Bat|eman's), and on unit or quote tokens ('degrees', '%', 'g', closing '?”' and '…”'). Pushed positive it steers toward quote, bracket and 'fire' tokens, and the text garbles.

L26n1562.name: Word-start 'par'/'b' pieces
L26n1562.description: Fires on the opening piece of a word the tokenizer split, especially 'par', 'b', 'po', 'wh', 'emb' and 'f' (par|mesan, b|reading, Par|thenon, wh|iff, po|achers, emb|rittlement, b|iodegradable). Pushed positive it steers output toward number words like 'five' and 'six'.

L26n268.name: Acronym openers in parentheses
L26n268.description: Goes strongly negative on the '(' that opens an abbreviation after a full name, and on the first capital letters of the acronym inside it (Active Template Library (ATL), (AIDS), (AHA), (LEAs), (MDA), (SSF), (AFM)). Pushed negative it steers the model into repeating 'AI'-style capitals.

L26n1263.name: Word-start 'sm/sp/K' fragments
L26n1263.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a word split into tokens, especially short consonant starts like 'sm', 'sp', 'squ', 'K' and 'I' (sm|ooching, sm|okes, sp|ayed, sp|ires, K|assites, poly|glots, satisf|actorily). Pushed negative it steers output toward ordinals like 'third' and 'fourth'.

L25n1027.name: Clause modal or negation
L25n1027.description: Fires on the modal, negation or relative word that opens a conditional, relative or purpose clause, e.g. 'if they fall', 'to not go', 'that might damage', 'who are', 'shall go', 'which produces', plus 'fire'. Pushed positive it steers toward 'exit', 'escape' and 'jump'.

L26n2779.name: Proper-name pieces, observation
L26n2779.description: Fires on the first or middle piece of a surname or place name split into tokens (Jean Laf|itte, Barg|uzin, Ras|porich, Ole|oestepa, Zar|ago|za, terra|cotta), and on 'hon' in 'honours' and 'Honk'. Pushed positive it steers toward 'observation' and 'observed'.

L26n1448.name: Mid-name subword pieces
L26n1448.description: Fires on a middle or later piece of a long name or foreign word split into several tokens (Mohen|jo|daro, Ash|kel|on, Jure P|isk|ur, kink|aj|us, Osh|k|osh, mont|aigne, accom|paniment). Pushed positive it steers toward short 'mo' fragments like 'mo' and 'mod'.

L25n2831.name: Capitalized 'Sl' word starts
L25n2831.description: Goes strongly negative hardest on the 'Sl' that opens a capitalized word (Slavery, Slaves, Slavic), and on other capitalized openers like Chern|obyl, Fern|heim, O|sh|kosh and 'Tibetan'. Pushed negative it steers output toward royal words: 'King', 'queen', 'royal', 'prince'.

L26n3013.name: Capital 'P' word starts
L26n3013.description: Fires on a capital 'P' that starts a capitalized word, usually a place, name or list-item opener (Palla, Potters, Patches, Pumsaint, Puffins, Pustules, Pacific, Pteridomania), and on 'ort' in Bortnyik. Pushed positive it steers output toward 'measurement'.

L26n2046.name: Short 'ro/Mer/Ar' word starts
L26n2046.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a word split into tokens, usually a short fragment starting with r, M, A or f (ro|selike, Ro|che, Mer|thyr, Mar|quesas, Ar|ctica, fer|ocious, Riv|iera). Pushed negative it steers output toward 'strategy'.

L26n1811.name: Word-start 'hal'/'prof' pieces
L26n1811.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, especially 'hal' (halos, halting, halving), 'prof' (professed, proficiency), 'reaff', 'Diff' and 'E' (E|MBASE). Pushed positive it steers output toward 'file' and 'download'.

L26n2439.name: Mid-word capitals and accents
L26n2439.description: Fires on a capital or accented letter inside a name or all-caps word, e.g. Jean-A|ntoine, IN|TE|LLIGENCE, CAR|TE|NOIRE, Gy|ö|rgy, El|ame|in, STE|AK, Marr|ake|ch. Pushed positive it steers toward consonant clusters like 'nt', 'nd' and 'll'.

L25n2761.name: Surname continuation pieces
L25n2761.description: Fires on a middle or late piece of a surname split into tokens (Roo|ze|boom, Macc|les|field, Cro|ple|y, McInt|ire, D|otten, Mack|in|ac, Whi|itting|ham). Pushed positive it steers toward 'release', 'issued' and 'emit'.

L26n2224.name: Word-piece 'und' and fragments
L26n2224.description: Fires on the opening or middle piece of a split word, most strongly 'und' (undies, undoubtedly, undeniably), plus 'ry', 'En', 'Hot', 'dre' and 'Bad' (apoc|ry|phal, Schoolwide|En|richment). Pushed positive it steers output toward 'schedule'.

L26n2101.name: Medical compound modifiers
L26n2101.description: Goes strongly negative on the modifier that opens a medical or technical compound, just before its head noun (hyper|methylation, odef|iciency, viral| loads, hyper|acusis, synd|romes, neonic|otinoid, AIDS|-prevention). Pushed negative it steers output toward 'activation' and 'activate'.

L25n561.name: Word stem before suffix
L25n561.description: Goes strongly negative on the first piece of a word that a suffix completes, right before the suffix (observ|ance, dos|ing, persist|ing, predict|ability, conserv|ativeness, occup|ant, know|-how). Pushed negative it steers output toward suffix-like endings 'gether' and 'etheless'.

L25n422.name: Joiner punctuation in compounds
L25n422.description: Fires on a joiner punctuation token inside a compound, number or formula, such as the '-' in 'omega-3' or 'Covid-19', the '.' in '1.000', the '_' in 'SiO_2', or a '(' opening an aside, just before the second half. Pushes toward no clear word; steered output degenerates into 'by the the'.

L26n1344.name: Split-word middle fragment
L26n1344.description: Goes negative on the second or middle piece of a rare word or name split into 3+ tokens, such as somat|OST|atin, Rolls|-R|oyce, tabula| r|asa or Shah| R|ukh, often a short 're', 'r' or 'ost'. Common whole words stay near 0. Pushes toward word-continuation fragments like 'res' and 'caffold'.

L26n2640.name: Generic split-word start
L26n2640.description: Goes negative on the first subword piece of a multi-token word of any kind, common or rare, where the rest of the word comes in the next token (cr|ickets, Hor|owitz, di|oceses, acc|idity, enc|odes, Rew|riting, Quick|-W|rites). Pushes toward short 'r' and 're' fragments.

L25n909.name: Consonant-cluster word start
L25n909.description: Fires on the first subword piece of a word split into tokens, mostly consonant-cluster or short starts such as thr (thrifty, thong), scr (scrupulous), pr (prays), ath (heathen), orm (Kormoran) and Pl. Pushes toward 'thanks', 'respect' and 'honor', and steered output spams 'Thank you'.

L26n2655.name: Rare name opening fragment
L26n2655.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a capitalized name or Latin/technical term split into tokens, such as Cr|ataegus, Para|íba, Can|averal, Mon|olithic and bre|vitomentosus. Pushes toward 'ou' and 'out' fragments, and steered output degenerates into 'out of the out of'.

L26n1959.name: Gender and sex terms
L26n1959.description: Goes negative on gender and sexuality words (gender, gendered, sexual, sexually, Sex) and on social-label words such as victim, demonize, idolize and self-advocacy, in text about discrimination and stereotypes. Pushes toward 'object' and 'objectification'.

L25n1025.name: Word-start fragment, writes '!'
L25n1025.description: Fires on the first piece of a word split into tokens, often a capitalized or short start such as Hon|shu, Kr|ill, Un|consoled, Kn|idos, Ar|thritis, Ver|bs and ser|fdom. Pushes toward '!', and steered output is only exclamation marks.

L25n1438.name: Auxiliary before main verb
L25n1438.description: Goes negative on a modal or auxiliary verb (has, have, had, can, may, could) that sits between a subject and its main verb, as in 'has so far not', 'can be overwhelming' or 'may not be as fair'. Pushes toward 'prove' and 'proved'.

L26n704.name: Mid-word fragment, 'incident'
L26n704.description: Goes negative on a short fragment in the middle of a long technical or rare word, such as hyp|OM|ethylation, retin|OB|lastoma, trihal|OM|ethanes, Epi|IP|hanes and UPV|E|HU. Pushes toward 'occurrence', 'incident' and 'phenomenon'.

L25n2875.name: 'public' before 'domain'
L25n2875.description: Fires on the word 'public', 'Public' or 'publicly' itself, as in public domain, Public Law, public good, public schools and Public Safety. Pushes toward 'domain', and steered output repeats 'domain'.

L26n57.name: Eco context, writes digits
L26n57.description: Goes negative on tokens inside eco, recycling, sustainability and product-description phrases, such as the 'and' in 'eco-friendly and sustainable', 'from' in 'made from recyclable', 'non-toxic', 'Earth Day' and 'Tampa'. The set is diffuse. Pushes toward digits and number lists.

L26n1210.name: ep/micro prefix fragment
L26n1210.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a word starting with the prefix 'ep' or 'micro' split into tokens, such as ep|inephrine, ep|igenetics, micro|bicides, micro|cephaly and micro|structure. Also fires on 'Te', 'ap' (apnea) and 'Tim' (Tim Burton). Pushes toward 'at' and 'ats', and steered output spams 'at'.

L25n1982.name: Computing operation word
L25n1982.description: Goes negative on the word that names a computation or arithmetic operation in a coding or math prompt, such as 'binary' in 'binary addition' or 'binary tree', 'performs', 'implements', and 'to' in 'recursion to calculate'. Pushes toward 'addition', 'add' and 'subtract'.

L25n1171.name: Opening quote or colon
L25n1171.description: Goes negative on the opening punctuation that introduces a named term, quote or list: an opening quote before a term, a colon plus newline before a list, a '?' plus newline before a list, and a '(' before a foreign term. Also 'revolution' in 'green revolution'. Pushes toward '_' identifier pieces.

L26n322.name: Hedge word before descriptor
L26n322.description: Fires on a degree or hedge word, and on the comma, 'or' or 'like' right before a descriptor, such as 'a little daunting', 'slightly darker', 'small, rather slow moving' and 'smaller fish like anchovies'. Pushes toward junk tokens like 'xAA'.

L26n386.name: Chat turn boundary newline
L26n386.description: Goes negative on the newline right after a user turn's '<|im_end|>', just before the assistant header, plus chat-template tags such as '<think>' and 'assistant'. Writes no clear word; it pushes toward junk fragments like '_da' and 'eden'.

L25n1095.name: Rare-name first piece
L25n1095.description: Goes negative on the first piece of a rare proper name split into tokens, such as Sam|oans, Char|on, Char|lemagne, Daw|es, Guz|mán and M|ennonite, and also on 'magnetic' and 'methyl'. Pushes toward 'measure', and steered output spams 'measure'.

L26n1944.name: Place-region word start
L26n1944.description: Goes negative on a geographic direction or region word that begins a place name or phrase, such as 'Middle' in 'Middle East', 'southern', 'Atlantic' coast, 'northeastern', 'tropical', and the 'P' in Pisa. Pushes toward 'park'.

L25n1627.name: Booking and travel words
L25n1627.description: Goes negative on travel and booking words such as book, hotel, flight, ticket, seat, lodging, cruise and airport, most strongly on 'book' before a room, ticket or seat. Pushes toward 'book', and steered output says 'I'd book a cozy room'.

L25n1931.name: URL start and 'come'
L25n1931.description: Fires on the 'https' or 'http' token that starts a pasted URL, after 'from', 'link:' or 'curl', and on 'come' in 'come out' or 'come to'. Pushes toward 'close', 'closest' and 'convergence', and steered output spams 'close your close'.

L26n1646.name: Mid-word subword fragment
L26n1646.description: Fires on a middle piece of a long word split into several tokens, while the word is still unfinished: 'gh' in sor|gh|um, 'g' in poly|g|amy, 'mac' in per|mac|ulture, 'ob' in mon|ob|actams. Pushes toward 'programming', 'logging' and 'coding' tokens.

L26n828.name: Hyphen-piece and name-start
L26n828.description: Fires on the piece right after a hyphen in a split compound ('h' of self-harm and hard-hitting, 'g' of second-guess), and on the first letter of some capitalized names (G of Gogh and Gutzon, Char of Charon, W of WMDs). Pushes toward closing code tokens such as ').' and '").'.

L25n2977.name: Connective before tool names
L25n2977.description: Fires on the word just before a software tool, skill or framework name in tech and job-posting text ('with' in familiarity with, 'using' before Gatsby, 'and' in XP and Scrum, 'on' in focus on), and on the first letter of such names (G of Gatsby, As of Asana). Pushes toward 'version' tokens.

L26n2607.name: First piece of names
L26n2607.description: Fires on the first token of a capitalized place, book or person name, or the first piece of a split word, e.g. 'T' in Tete Province, Treatise, Tigris; 'Bo' in Bois Blanc; 'Y' in Yogyakarta; 'spe' in asparagus spears; 'blo' in blooming. Pushes toward 'property' and 'properties'.

L25n24.name: Preposition before place/source
L25n24.description: Fires strongly negative on the preposition right after a verb or noun that opens a source, place or agent phrase: 'from' in launched from Cape Canaveral, 'by' in dropped by the B-29, 'at' in professor at, 'as' in known as, 'of' after a noun. Also fires on 'yes' and '?'. Pushes toward code tokens like '('{' and '()]', with no clear steering effect.

L26n518.name: Mid-name subword piece
L26n518.description: Fires strongly negative on a later piece of a proper name split into tokens, e.g. 'Mah' in Taj Mah|al, 'Maz' in Maz|aheri, 'iz' in Night V|iz, 'Mos' in Mos|he, 'Woz' in Woz|niak, 'Geh' in Geh|rig, 'Gar' in Gar|uda. Pushes toward UI words such as 'screen', 'dialog' and 'gui'.

L26n1716.name: Name fragments, past-tense push
L26n1716.description: Fires negative on a piece of a multi-token proper name, e.g. 'Pan' in Pan|aridus and Arvind Pan, 'Hash' in Hash|em, 'Hos' in Hos|feld, 'bed' in Am|bed|kar, 'ania' in Zephaniah, plus 'and' and 'or' joining items in a clause. Pushes toward past-tense verbs 'did', 'came', 'grew' and 'took'.

L26n809.name: Digits inside measurements
L26n809.description: Fires negative on a digit inside a numeric measurement with units: '6' in -286 kJ/mol, '8' in 8.34 km, '0' in 1,060 miles and 600 degrees C, '1' in 26,001 pounds, '.' in 22.8 C. Also fires on 'Figure', 'Section' and 'Chapter' labels. Pushes toward code-closing tokens such as ';' and ')', with no clear steering effect.

L26n985.name: Word-start stem pieces
L26n985.description: Fires negative on the opening piece of a word split into tokens, mostly medical or Latin-Greek stems: 'som' in somatostatin, 'metaph' in metaphysical, 'tab' in tabula, 'app' in appalled, 'met' in metropolis, 'ass' in Dassault. Also on 'World' and 'American' before a fixed name. Pushes toward 'economic' and 'economy'.

L26n722.name: Modal before effect verb
L26n722.description: Fires negative on a modal ('can', 'will', 'can be', 'can actually') placed right before the verb of an effect or outcome in explanatory prose: 'screen time can have', 'can actually damage', 'will lead to', 'can encourage', 'potential to undermine'. Pushes toward 'achieve', 'achieved' and 'achievable'.

L25n2158.name: 'That' before result clause
L25n2158.description: Fires negative on the word right after a noun that opens a relative or result clause: 'that' in a substance that results, a tumor that affects, shortness of breath that. Also on 'will', 'may' and 'instead' before an outcome verb ('will grow', 'may instead originate'). Pushes toward 'result' and 'results'.

L25n1823.name: Fact and check words
L25n1823.description: Fires negative on words in quiz, worksheet and fact-check text: 'Fact' in Chronic Fatigue - Fact versus Fiction, 'self' in self-checking answer cards, 'grammar' in workbook titles, 'guessing' in games, plus 'Quiz' and 'Quick'. Pushes toward 'check', 'checked' and 'checking'.

L26n1473.name: Chemical word prefix pieces
L26n1473.description: Fires negative on the early piece of a chemistry or medical word split into tokens: 'chlor' in chlor|ides and chlor|inated, 'hydro' and 'dro' in hydro|gen, hydro|testosterone and hydro|xyapatite, 'rom' in dichromate, 'd' in d|ialysate, 'cyst' in polycyst|ic. Pushes toward 'dis' word-start pieces.

L26n528.name: Word-start noun fragments
L26n528.description: Fires positive on the opening piece of a noun or name split into tokens, e.g. 'bl' in bl|ower speed, 'blo' in blo|ating and blo|oming, 'plac' in plac|enta, 'Co' and 'rd' in Co|rd|oba, 'ass' in K|ass|ites. Pushes toward attribute nouns such as 'price', 'temperature', 'age' and 'weight'.

L26n2828.name: Rare-name first piece
L26n2828.description: Fires positive on the first piece of a rare name or word split into tokens, e.g. 'Hash' in Hash|em, 'Ast' in Ast|ola, 'Mag' in Mag|hreb, 'Mun' in Mun|yarugamba and Mun|itions, 'ast' in ast|axanthin, 'gu' in gu|erilla. Pushes toward 'translation' and 'translated'.

L26n922.name: Long-word piece, sent push
L26n922.description: Fires negative on a piece of a multi-token proper name or long word that carries its identity: 'Mah' in Taj Mah|al, 'Maj' in Maj|orelle, 'ad' in Mad|ison, 'Mes' in Mes|opotamia, 'reck' in reck|oned, 'ind' in ind|elibly. Pushes toward 'sent' tokens.

L26n1080.name: Place-name opening piece
L26n1080.description: Fires negative on the first token of a place or proper name whose next token completes it: 'Cape' in Cape Town, Cape Canaveral and Cape Wildlife; 'Cal' in Calvary and Calle; 'Anch' in Anchorage; 'Nan' in Nanaimo; 'Ang' in Angolan. Pushes toward 'above' and 'below'.

L25n865.name: Name fragment, brace push
L25n865.description: Fires negative on a piece of a split proper name or long word: 'ar' in Acidov|arans, 'arr' in Mar|rakesh, 'Zam' in Zam|bezi, 'Nav' in Nav|ajo, 'Tur' in Tur|bine, 'Pall' in Pall|ene, 'of' in nan|of|abrication. Pushes toward '{' brace tokens, with no clear behavioral effect.

L26n1765.name: The word 'blood'
L26n1765.description: Fires negative on the word 'blood' in medical and biology text, strongest on 'blood' before vessel, clot, flow or stream, and on the '-br' piece of 'blood-brain'. Pushes toward 'component' continuations.

L26n666.name: Name opening piece, pattern
L26n666.description: Fires negative on the opening piece of a name split into tokens, e.g. 'Ash' in Ash|kelon, 'Suk' in Suk|hpur, 'Rab' in Rab|ier, 'Wak' in Wak|ayama, 'Sp' in Sp|inal, 'pa' in pa|lettes, 'ra' in sauerk|raut. Pushes toward 'pattern' tokens.
